dishes.name: Banak
dishes.desc: Lamb, mutton or beef slow-cooked in a tray over pide bread and often served with pilaf. A traditional dish of the Isparta kitchen.

dishes.name: Rose Turkish delight
dishes.desc: Turkish delight flavoured with real rose from the Isparta rose fields, which locals prefer to versions made with rose water.

dishes.name: Yalvaç güllacı
dishes.desc: A rose-shaped rolled güllaç dessert made with a milk-based, lor-like cheese, different from other güllaç varieties. Named for the Isparta town of Yalvaç.

dishes.name: Burdur şiş
dishes.desc: Lamb or goat minced with tail fat and seasoned with salt only, grilled on skewers and usually eaten with pide. A Burdur speciality.

dishes.name: Bucak kömbe
dishes.desc: Round dough pastry filled with tahini, walnut, molasses or poppy seed and oil, common around Bucak in Burdur province.
